title: Lemon and Brandy Mousse
blurb: A light, set mousse with sharp lemon and a hint of brandy, chilled until firm.
steps: Sprinkle the gelatin over the cold water in a small bowl and leave to sponge for five minutes.
Separate the eggs, putting the yolks in a heatproof bowl and the whites in a large clean bowl.
Add 100g of the sugar and the lemon zest to the yolks and whisk until pale, then whisk in the lemon juice.
Set the bowl over a pan of simmering water and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, about ten minutes.
Remove from the heat, stir in the soaked gelatin until dissolved, then stir in the brandy and leave to cool to room temperature.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and whisk the egg whites with the remaining 50g sugar to stiff peaks.
Fold the cream into the cooled lemon mixture, then gently fold in the egg whites until no streaks remain.
Divide between eight serving glasses or pour into one large dish, then refrigerate for at least three hours until set.
